title: Luigi’s Mansion 3
description:
Luigi’s invited to the towering Last Resort hotel, but when Mario and friends go missing, our green-clad hero will have to conquer his fears to save them! Slam, blow away, and vacuum up ghosts with the all-new Poltergust G-00, and join forces with Gooigi to overcome the puzzling contraptions and mischievous boss on each themed floor. And that’s just the Last Resort. Enter the ScareScraper for 8-player local wireless* or online** co-op gameplay.

See if you can defeat all the ghosts, rescue all the toads, or clear other objectives before time runs out…in the ScareScraper! And for more mini-game madness, compete on teams at the ScreamPark! Whether you play with friends or wander the hotel alone, you’ll be sucked in by the atmospheric music and ghoulish décor of every cobwebby corner you explore. Why not take in the cinematic sights and sounds with a friend? In the main adventure, you and a friend can play together as Luigi and Gooigi in two-player co-op! Gooigi can walk on spikes, slip through tight spaces, and help Luigi overcome obstacles he can’t tackle alone. Never hurts to have a friend in this hotel; it may not be very spooky, but Luigi begs to differ!

•	Catch ghosts and solve puzzles to rescue Mario and friends in the Last Resort hotel
•	Each floor of this towering hotel is themed, from the décor to the puzzles to boss!
•	Utilize the functions of the all-new Poltergust G-00: Pummel ghosts with a Slam, break through defenses with the Suction Shot, and blow back groups with a Burst
•	Luigi can call upon and control Gooigi, his all-green doppelganger, who can do what Luigi can’t
•	Gooigi can slip through tight spaces, walk on spikes, and help Luigi overcome obstacles
•	Change between Luigi and Gooigi in single player, or let a friend play as Gooigi for 2-player co-op
•	Up to 8 players can work together to ascend the ScareScraper via local wireless or online
•	It’s Team Luigi vs. Team Gooigi in a mini-game battle to see which is the ultimate team of ghost hunters

gameplayPillars.title: Poltergust ghost hunting
gameplayPillars.description: Capture ghosts by stunning, slamming, and vacuuming them with the upgraded Poltergust G-00.

gameplayPillars.title: Gooigi puzzle solving
gameplayPillars.description: Summon Gooigi to pass through grates, avoid hazards Luigi cannot, and enable co-op play.

gameplayPillars.title: Hotel floor exploration
gameplayPillars.description: Each floor has a distinct theme, secrets, collectibles, and environmental puzzles.

gameplayPillars.title: Boss encounters
gameplayPillars.description: Named ghosts use unique gimmicks that turn major fights into multi-step puzzles.

gameplayPillars.title: ScareScraper and ScreamPark
gameplayPillars.description: Separate multiplayer modes support cooperative or competitive sessions beyond the story.

storyChapters.title: Rescue E. Gadd

storyChapters.title: Climb themed floors
storyChapters.body: Each hotel floor introduces a new visual theme, boss ghost, and puzzle style.

storyChapters.title: Use Gooigi to progress
storyChapters.body: Gooigi becomes essential for split-body puzzles and local co-op exploration.

storyChapters.body: The adventure builds toward rescuing Mario, Peach, and the Toads from King Boo’s plan.

features: Story campaign with themed hotel floors

faq.a: Yes. The story supports Gooigi co-op, while ScareScraper and ScreamPark support larger multiplayer groups.
Next Level Games developed Luigi’s Mansion 3 and Nintendo published it.
It is a Nintendo Switch game and can be played on Switch 2 through backward compatibility.
It uses a haunted-hotel theme but is designed as a family-friendly action-puzzle adventure.
A Multiplayer Pack adds costumes, themed floors, and multiplayer content.

verdictCons: Single-player pacing can slow during collectible hunts
Some multiplayer content is separate from story progression
Backtracking appears late in the campaign
storageNotes: Nintendo lists a 7.38 GB download. Free-space requirements can increase with updates.

storySummary: King Boo traps Mario, Peach, and the Toads inside paintings at the Last Resort hotel. Luigi climbs its themed floors with Professor E. Gadd, Polterpup, and Gooigi to rescue them.

music: The haunted-hotel score changes with each themed floor; Nintendo does not list a standalone soundtrack on the eShop product page.
completionTime: Nintendo does not publish an official story-hour estimate; completion varies with exploration, gems, Boos, and co-op play.
completionistTime: Nintendo does not publish an official 100% time; collecting every gem and Boo and clearing multiplayer objectives adds substantial playtime.
cons: Some multiplayer content is paid DLC
Online multiplayer requires Nintendo Switch Online
verdictSummary: A polished action-puzzle adventure with memorable themed floors, excellent animation, flexible Gooigi co-op, and separate multiplayer modes.
